text: Tarski's theorem characterizes the models of General Extensional Mereology (GEM) as exactly:
choices: complete Boolean algebras with the bottom (zero) element removed
complete lattices possessing both a top and a bottom element
explanation: Tarski (1935) showed GEM's models are precisely complete Boolean algebras with the bottom element deleted — the excised zero being the absent null individual. Plain partial orders are only models of the weak system M; GEM keeps no bottom (option 2 wrong); and GEM is neutral on atomicity, so it is not restricted to atomic algebras (option 3 wrong).
